title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: ALS driver family + wear-detect + charge-callback glue verified function-level vs stock (Renode 1.17 cortex-m55)

method.emulator: Renode 1.17.0 (vendor/renode-src e8c7c2d), cortex-m55 FPU enabled, bundled dotnet 8.0.425
method.harness: build/ws-hwdrivers-20261122/harness; autogen.py now resolves symbols from a repo-wide symbol->address index harvested from all apollo-main source address comments (RAM/ROM/Stock/native 0xADDR), not just the unit under test. opt3007 goes over I2C (modelled). All FP-aware (VFP s0-s3).
method.design: stock bodies run in place from stock.app.bin @0x00438000; reconstructed C linked into ITCM. Cross-module callees stubbed at stock addresses; als RAM state globals (curve index/adjusted/nominal, scale active/shadow/clamped, manual level/target_count, recompute_pending, default/active previous, opt3007 regmap) seeded identically and diffed. Unit-defined globals that have a stock RAM address (e.g. audio_als_manual_target_count @0x200741fc) are now placed at that absolute address in the C link so both variants share the same storage.
method.inputs: 15-20 randomized cases per function, stock vs C, log flags 0 and 7; argument fuzzing restricted to valid firmware domains (e.g. curve index 0..5).

als_brightness_curve.note: als_function_15 (g2_als_curve_table[index].percent) verified on the valid index domain 0..5; out-of-range index is an unguarded table read the firmware never issues.

notes: Function-level equivalence only. No sources.json/linker/build changes; no git; no flash.
reverification_notes: Re-verified under the final arg-comparing + VFP-aware harness and the global-merge-off build (-fno-common -mllvm -arm-global-merge=false); 0 mismatches in the 2026-11-22 19:12 CST full batch re-run.
